profile_text.body:
Repurpose, founded in 2017, operates repurpose.io, a platform the company describes as the "#1 automated content repurposing and distribution platform." The service is aimed at helping users publish video and other content consistently across multiple social platforms, including Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, with the company emphasizing time savings and simplified sharing as its core value proposition.

The platform is tracked under the Video Generation and Editing category, with noted capabilities including content distribution automation, multi-platform publishing, workflow automation, and API access. The company offers a free tier allowing users to publish ten videos without a credit card, with paid plans available for additional accounts, higher usage limits, and premium automation features. No litigation, regulatory filings, or MCP registry presence are recorded in the held facts.
